additions.distinctness_review: Screened on 27 October 2026 against all five tables (sites.csv, projects.csv, evidence.csv, source-records.json, identity-mapping.json) of verified_construction_core/2026-10-27-research-ninetyeighth (read from site/config.json at the time of screening; first screened against ninety-seventh and re-screened against ninety-eighth), all sources/*-holds.json, every pending queue fragment's changes.json and holds.json, and claims.tsv, for 日野台, 日野市, Hino and any coordinate within 2 km of the point. No Atlas site, project, evidence record, source record or pending addition lies within 2 km or names the plan; the nearest Atlas sites are OME Data Center04 (Shinmachi 9-A) at 13.3 km and TECRA Ome Takinouecho at 16.7 km. The only matching holds are this same candidate's earlier holds (research-countries-2026-10-16-thirtyfirst, -10-22-thirtyfourth: 'Hino-dai data centre plan (Mitsui Fudosan)' and 'Mitsui Fudosan (仮称)日野市日野台3丁目計画', both waiting for an in-window Hino City or Mitsui record; and the -10-23-fiftyfifth / jp-kanto-p2 Mitsui Sagamihara and Hino re-check), which this addition resolves; Mitsui Fudosan's separate Sagamihara project is not affected. Hino Motors' operating Hino plant east of the outline is excluded.

locator.identity_review: The developer material published by Hino City gives the site as 日野台3丁目1番32,33,34の一部 and 日野台4丁目31番1,2,5, the former Hino Motors west plant, 114,037.24 m2, and the city's FY2025 overview gives the same lots and area with Mitsui Fudosan as landowner. The page-8 site plan was registered to the GSI z18 standard map by a six-point similarity (two drawn tanks north-east of the site and the four corners of the 日野台公園 block to its west): RMS 1.6 m, rotation -20.9 degrees, matching the plan's north arrow; the registered outline's geodesic area, 113,751 m2, is within 0.3% of the official area. On the GSI seamless aerial it follows the residential lot line on the west and 甲州街道 on the south and encloses the former west-plant buildings and cleared ground, excluding the Hino Motors main plant to the east. The registration was prepared on 17 October 2026 by an earlier lane and re-derived on 27 October 2026 from the recorded control points, with the source PDF and all 98 tiles rehashed and the marker tile re-fetched unchanged (geometry facts). Hino's 2026 MOJ/AIGID public-coordinate parcel file has no 日野台3丁目 or 4丁目 parcels, so no cadastral locator exists; GSI chome points, the Hino Motors head-office address point (日野台3-1-1) and the city centre are excluded.
locator.precision: Parent-property marker inside the 114,037 m2 development site (former Hino Motors west plant) outlined on the developer's page-8 site plan and registered to GSI z18 tiles; it is the outline's pole of inaccessibility, about 124 m inside the boundary. It does not locate any of the three planned buildings, the data halls, a substation, an entrance or a surveyed lot boundary.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The source is a 0.66 m-per-pixel developer site plan without geodetic control, traced by hand and registered to the GSI standard map; control residuals (RMS 1.6 m, independent south-west-corner check 5.4 m) measure registration consistency, not ground accuracy, and GSI standard-map accuracy is not stated. The marker is chosen for its clearance inside a site that extends a few hundred metres in each direction; decimal places are arithmetic precision.

status.summary: Hino City Council's list of general questions notified for its third regular session of 2026 (updated 27 August 2026) names the plan twice: a question calling for 'Mitsui Fudosan's Hino-dai data-centre construction' to be frozen and assessed, set for 5 October, and one opposing 'the start of the Hino-dai data centre's site-grading works in October', set for 7 October. On 29 September 2026 the council rejected a petition asking for the start of a data centre's construction to be postponed. The plan, identified by Hino City and its proponent Mitsui Fudosan as the (仮称)日野市日野台3丁目計画, is a three-building data-centre development on the 114,037.24 m2 former Hino Motors west plant at 日野台3丁目1番32-34 (part) and 日野台4丁目31番1, 2, 5. The council record supports announced status as of 27 August 2026. No building confirmation, start of site works or later stage is recorded; the October 2026 grading start is a planned date, and the published floor area and power figures are plans, not capacity in service.

additions.successor_review: Checked on 27 October 2026: the council's results page (updated 30 September) shows the 29 September rejection of the petition to postpone a data centre's construction start; minutes of the 5 and 7 October general questions are not yet published; the Environmental Council page is unchanged since 5 August 2026 (no second FY2026 meeting); the October 2026 issue of the city newsletter (text edition) has no data-centre item; Mitsui Fudosan's news index has no later Hino item. Hino City notices under its town-planning ordinance of 23 October 2026 (公告第252号 and 第253号, a changed-plan compliance notice and a changed agreement) were seen only as titles in the city's new-information list and were not opened because robots.txt disallows /shisei/koukokushiki/; their subject is unknown and nothing is inferred from them. No building confirmation, start of grading or construction, or change of plan was found, so the status stays announced as of 27 August 2026.
